title: Figure 55: Factors that determine the energy returned by a radar target
description: Illustration of a radar beam radiating from an antenna toward a target, with four numbered callouts: (1) "Power of Waves Radiated Toward Target," (2) "Fraction of Intercepted Power Scattered Toward Radar," (3) "Fraction of Backscatter Captured by Antenna," and (4) "Time on Target" shown with a millisecond clock dial. The caption reads "Figure 55. Factors that Determine the Energy Returned by a Target (Aerospaceweb.org, 2010)." It opens section 4.2.3, "Radar Cross Section Analysis of a Spherical UFO," page 83.
